title: fix: avoid double-encoding data: URL audio inputs
author: zilin6666LYNSUN
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16368

## What

`input_audio` parts whose `data` is already an encoded `data:` URL were being wrapped again with `data:audio/<format>;base64,`, creating a double-encoded payload that fails inline media validation (HTTP 400 for offloaded parts) or is rejected by the upstream Fireworks provider (small parts). This mirrors the `data:` prefix handling that already exists for `file`/`file_data` in `large-chat-body.ts`.

## Changes

- `gen.pollinations.ai/src/middleware/large-chat-body.ts`: in `inlineMedia()`'s `input_audio` branch, use the `data` payload as-is when it already starts with `data:` (guarding that it is `data:audio/`), otherwise wrap bare base64 as before.
- `gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/transforms/inputAudioToFireworks.ts`: pass through `data:audio/` URLs instead of re-wrapping them.
- Tests: extended `large-chat-body.test.ts` to offload a mix of bare base64 and data-URL audio (verifying each mime type is preserved), and `inputAudioToFireworks.test.ts` to assert data-URL audio is forwarded unchanged.

## Test

- `npx vitest run test/large-chat-body.test.ts` → 5/5 passed
- `npx vitest run test/text/transforms/inputAudioToFireworks.test.ts` → 1/1 passed

gist.headline: One wrapper is plenty
gist.blurb: Audio that arrives in a data URL keeps its wrapper. Bare base64 still gets one, because one is the correct number.
gist.summary: The chat gateway preserves existing data:audio/ URLs in both large-body media offloading and Fireworks input-audio conversion, while continuing to wrap bare base64 audio.
gist.impact: Audio requests using data:audio/ URLs avoid the double-wrapping that caused HTTP 400 validation errors or Fireworks rejections, and bare base64 inputs continue to work.
